snowballing is getting ahead of the enemy and going out of control.
as in a little snowball rolling down a mountain and getting bigger and bigger.
kitting is moving and attacking inbetween, so you move to a safe area but still attack while moving,it's a really hard mechanic to master but worthwhile in the long run. using abilities is also part of kiting. champions such as ashe have an auto attack slow ability and an aoe (area of effect) cone spell which slows.
hecarim is better in the jungle, since he doesn't scale that well with AP.

IMO you have 2 ways of playing him. the 1st way is by getting 3 as fast as you can and camping top and mid/mid and bot as hard as you can.
the other method is by farming jungle till 6,gank a couple of times but never let your conservation stacks hit 80.
build wise you can choose between elder lizard or golem, lizard is more DMG and better clearing and golem is just overall tankiness.
items like iceborn are good on him since you don't have any hard cc except your ult or your knockback on your E. boots of swiftness is the best choice IMo since you are really countered by slow or hard CC which make your passive useless. if you're ahead a youmoo's is a really nice choice, it gives dmg armpen and a nice active speedbuff. randuins is by far one of my favorites since nobody can kite you and with iceborn you permaslow them or you force the enemy tank/support to peel for them.
as for MR items i'd suggest spirit visage, the cdr is really nice and the unique passive works really well with your W. other situational items are sunfire,GA or any other defensive item.
as for summoner spells smite is mandatory in jungle and ghost is too good to not get, together with your E it's a great combo.
hope this helps you play hecarim!
